title: Software Engineer, Kernel and BIOS - Dublin, Ireland
description:
Who You'll Work With
The Platform team who are the programmers working closest to the hardware and programming chips. Arista Networks is looking for world-class Linux Kernel and BIOS software engineers to join our Dublin Kernel software team. Our Kernel team is responsible for keeping pace with the latest developments in the Linux Kernel and integrating them for our internal use, both for development and as a base for Arista EOS to run on. This work often involves extending and developing new kernel features related to functionality that we rely on and working with the kernel community to get them integrated upstream. Kernel software engineers are also responsible for the CPU subsystems on all Arista products. You will evaluate new CPUs and work with CPU/BIOS vendors to integrate their stacks into EOS. You will also be responsible for bringup and qualification of these components into our hardware products.
What You'll Do
Arista Software Engineering roles demand a strong and broad software engineering background. While the primary focus area for this role is Kernel/BIOS software, the role will cover all aspects of software development spanning the addition of new features, debugging problems and fine tuning code for scalability and performance. You will own your projects from definition to deployment and customer interactions, and you will be responsible for the quality of everything you deliver.
Arista Software Engineering prides itself on a supportive and growth oriented culture. Over time, as your interests change, coupled with evolving business needs you will have the opportunity to switch from Kernel and BIOS to other areas, if you like.

• BS Computer Science/Electrical Engineering/Computer Engineering

• 5+ years experience of C or C++ and Python.

• Hands-on experience working on Linux Kernel software is a plus.

• Understanding of IP networking and/or distributed systems is a plus.

• Applied understanding of software engineering principles.

• Strong problem solving and software troubleshooting skills.

• Ability to design a solution and implement it successfully.

Arista Networks is an industry leader in data-driven, client-to-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. What sets us apart is our relentless pursuit of innovation. We leverage the latest advancements in cloud computing, artificial intelligence, and software-defined networking to provide our clients with a competitive edge in an increasingly interconnected world. Our solutions are designed to not only meet the current demands of the digital landscape but to also anticipate and adapt to future challenges.
At Arista we value the diversity of thought and perspectives that each employee brings to the table. We believe that fostering an inclusive environment, where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome, is essential for driving creativity and innovation.
Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as Best Engineering Team, Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work-Life Balance. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest standards of quality and performance in everything we do.

title: Senior Supplier Quality Engineer
tags: Quality Reliability & System Safety : Quality Engineering
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

As a Senior Supplier Quality Engineer on the Sentry products team, you will work inside and outside the organization to define, develop, and execute processes that deliver high quality and reliable products for Anduril's Sentry autonomous surveillance systems and the critical components that make successful sourcing solutions. You will play a critical role in ensuring the reliability, quality, and performance of components and sub-assemblies across Sentry's core commodity families - PCBA, structures and power, radar, and imaging - that enable Sentry to operate in demanding field environments. Everything comes down to clarity and action with our suppliers, and partnering with them for world-class results is essential across the supply chain. The right person for this role has knowledge of manufacturing across multiple commodity types, supply management, supplier development, sub-system performance criteria and metrology, and continuous improvement. If you are someone who loves to build world-class quality processes, work hands-on, and be accountable for results, then this role is for you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Drive the supplier quality development processes throughout the product development stages with the Sentry product engineering team through design reviews, supplier process development, testing, and qualification for components and sub-assemblies across Sentry's commodity families: PCBA, structures and power, radar, and imaging. Review supplier processes and capabilities to ensure alignment to product, part, and sub-assembly requirements.

• Provide technical expertise for manufacturing and outsourcing processes across commodities - including printed circuit board assemblies, structural and power systems, radar modules, and imaging sensor assemblies. Drive the gathering of data and insights from suppliers to conduct top-tier evaluations of manufacturability, quality, cost-efficiency, capability, and audit compliance.

• Partner with development engineering (mechanical, electrical, RF, and optical/systems), product quality engineering, and program management to deliver predictable supply to Sentry development programs and production programs, and manage exceptions, containments, and deviations for supplier technical performance.

• Drive supplier quality readiness by analyzing key and critical characteristics for drawings, schematics, and supplier specifications, develop measurement systems and inspection criteria, and lead supplier qualification activities (PPAP, FAIR, MSA, Audit, inspection development, PFMEA & AS9102, etc.).

• Partner with Category Management and Sourcing Engineering to drive overall supplier performance for cost, quality, delivery, and fulfillment of strategic goals across all four commodity families.

• Own the elimination of supplier risk to improve quality and reliability across the Sentry product lifecycle, from early prototyping through scaled production. Utilize audits, readiness reviews, and training and documentation to ensure compliance.

• Work cross-functionally to define and execute the technology/vendor capability roadmap and delivery schedules needed for future Sentry variants, proof-of-concepts, prototypes, and explorations.

• Support Root Cause and Corrective Action (RCCA)

title: Senior Copywriter (Sports Emphasis)
description:
WHO WE ARE 

We’re Hook-an award-winning creative content agency. With a collaborative, maker-centric team and an emphasis on production-led design, we make ads, campaigns, and experiences that drive growth for the world’s most innovative brands.

Our mission is to integrate creative and production to help grow brands faster, but we believe what’s most important are the people who work with us and the experience they have along the way. We want clients to think of us as the best agency they’ve ever worked with, and we want everyone at Hook to feel like this is the best job they’ve had yet.

 

WHAT’S A SENIOR COPYWRITER AT HOOK?  

Senior Copywriters aim to solve client marketing challenges with an emphasis on ideating creative concepts, developing messaging strategy, speaking within a designated brand narrative, and technical constraint writing. Regardless of output medium, their core responsibilities include insightful concept development, detailed creative oversight during campaign production, and hands-on writing across multiple workstreams.

A great Senior Copywriter is an experienced and articulate advertising leader that’s capable of collaboratively guiding clients through the creative process. They strike a balance between performing individual contributor duties and working toward broader solutions as part of a creative leadership cohort. They intelligently lead projects through all phases of development, from research and pitching to delivery - acting as a skilled interface between client needs and production capabilities, ultimately working to ensure the success of all work they touch - whether delegating or directly completing.

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO  

• Lead the creation of brand messaging and themes that succeed across mediums, formats, and campaign types with a focus on Direct Response writing.

• Lead conceptual development and pitching efforts by writing and/or directing strategically driven messaging and creative deliverables.

• Lead client-facing conversations focused on the development and refinement of campaign messaging. 

• Work with producers to ensure copy is delivered on deadline and in accordance with brand standards and client criteria.

• Maintain a positive working relationship with Motion and Design, ensuring that concepts meet the requirements for all formats and mediums.

• Maintain and promote an internal awareness of industry creative trends and standards with a strong focus on narrative tone and ideation.

• Explore AI tools related to messaging, ideation, and tasks that impact client work

• Mentor and support junior creative staff toward the goal of accelerating skill progression through a culture of collaboration and knowledge sharing.

• Offer the team support through creative problem-solving, process improvements, synthesizing briefs, and elevating the work, with a focus on areas other than copywriting.

 

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

• Agency or equivalent copywriting experience for national and/or global brands, with some experience in tech, product features.

• An interest in sports and broadcast entertainment.

• The ability to project a conversational and experienced temperament when presenting.

• An inspiring portfolio of work that successfully addresses complex marketing objectives.

• A collaborative spirit, with the ability to navigate workstreams and effectively communicate.

• A proactive mindset towards solving client challenges and driving work forward.

 

WHAT ELSE

Qualified applicants will include a resume and a statement of interest that allows us to learn a little more about you.

We are a remote first organization with a “work from wherever” approach (within the US). We're a collaborative group of people who love the internet, and want to create phenomenal work. Company benefits include health, dental, matching 401k, paid vacation and holidays, and more. 

At Hook, we value what makes everyone different. We look for the best talent,

title: Product Manager

Our people are the backbone of everything we do and are our most valuable asset. Our business model demands top talent across the board, and we aim to create conditions that attract and retain the best individuals globally.
﻿Role Overview
We are expanding our Product team, and this role owns a slice of the internal product ecosystem our teams run the business on.
Your starting focus is the Media Buyer Automation Platform - the rules engine, pacing logic, spend controls, alerting, and workflow tooling that let a small team of buyers manage budgets that would otherwise require significantly more headcount. From there, your scope extends across the internal tools that support the wider acquisition engine: marketing automation, reporting and analytics workflows, creative operations, and the new tooling we build as the business shifts. We expect the exact portfolio to evolve, and we are hiring someone who wants that rather than someone looking for a single fixed product.
This is a hands-on builder role rather than a coordination role. Your users are colleagues, the feedback loop is short, and your work shows up in CPA, ROAS, wasted spend, and hours returned to the team. You will report to the Head of Product and work daily with Engineering, Data, Media Buying, Creative, and Operations.
Responsibilities

﻿
﻿1. Product Strategy & Roadmap

• Own the end-to-end roadmap for the Media Buyer Automation Platform, including discovery, prioritization, specifications, delivery, adoption, and iteration.

• Take on additional internal products as the portfolio grows, sequencing work across marketing automation, reporting and analytics, creative operations, cross-platform account management, and data reconciliation while maintaining focus on the core platform.

2. User Needs & Automation

• Work closely with media buyers to understand their workflows and translate their operational needs into reliable automation for budget pacing, anomaly alerts, spend guardrails, bulk actions, and approval flows.

• Identify manual processes that are consuming capacity across the business and evaluate whether they should be automated through internal development, external solutions, or left unchanged.

3. Product Development & Delivery

• Write clear product specifications that engineers can build from, including edge cases, failure modes, rollback behavior, and a defined bar for completion.

• Prototype ideas and build lightweight automations where this can accelerate alignment or address smaller workflow needs without relying on the engineering roadmap.

4. Adoption, Measurement & Collaboration

The Position
We're assembling a small founding team to build something genuinely hard: high-throughput services that inspect live traffic, terminate and analyze TLS in the data path, and hold near-zero latency while doing it. This is real systems engineering - streaming, distributed, latency-obsessed - not another CRUD app behind a form.
You won't be starting cold. You inherit real infrastructure and real users, which means what you build reaches production in weeks, not years. The work is high-leverage from day one, and there's nowhere to hide - in the best way.

You take a capability from a rough idea all the way to production, and then you keep it alive and healthy there - meeting its latency and reliability targets, instrumented well enough to prove it, and hardened to survive real load and real failure. You own the outcome, not the ticket. You'll lead a functional area end to end: set its technical direction, make the calls that matter, and pull other engineers along with you.
Who You Are

• You see what needs to exist and you go build it - you spot the gap, scope it yourself, and start, instead of waiting for someone to hand you a task or a spec.

• You own the entire arc - design, build, ship, operate - and you treat what happens in production as your responsibility, making sure the system behaves exactly within the parameters it's supposed to, not just that it passed in staging.

• When you hit the edge of what you know - a protocol you've never touched, a failure mode you've never seen - curiosity and sheer grit carry you across it faster than most people expect.

• "Good enough" makes you uncomfortable; you hold a high bar for yourself and ship work you're genuinely proud to put your name on.

What You Bring

• Proven, demonstrable proficiency using AI as a force multiplier - you already operate as a 10x engineer, orchestrating AI tools and agents to design, build, and ship far beyond what you could alone, while keeping the judgment to know what "correct" actually looks like.

• 5-7+ years building and operating production services and front ends, with real experience owning something end to end and carrying the weight of it once it's in front of real users.

• Hands-on experience with TLS / MITM inspection and the security-sensitive edge cases that come with sitting in the middle of live traffic.

• A real track record of taming latency in streaming and distributed systems - you've chased down p99 tail latency and know that "fast on my machine" means nothing until it's fast in production, under load, with observability to back it up.

• Strong command of a modern backend language (Go, Rust, or TypeScript/Node) and React/TypeScript on the front end, with a deep working grasp of HTTP, TLS, gRPC/REST, and async/streaming I/O.

title: Product Manager, Developer Tools & Compiler
description:
About IonQ: 

IonQ, Inc . [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance .

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.  

We are looking for a technical, detail-oriented Product Manager to own the product backlog for IonQ's developer tools and compiler. This includes our SDK, compilation and optimization toolchain, simulators, and integrations with popular quantum frameworks. You'll be part of IonQ's Compute Product Management team. You'll embed with the engineering teams that build these tools and help turn strategy into clear, prioritized, buildable work.

In this role, you'll be the day-to-day product partner for engineering. You'll translate developer and customer needs into well-defined requirements, set and defend priorities, write acceptance criteria that make "done" clear, and make sure what ships solves real user problems. You'll work closely with Engineering, Developer Experience, Applications Research, and Customer Success to shape how researchers and developers build on IonQ hardware.

You don't need a background in quantum computing. You DO need a strong technical foundation, real empathy for developers, and the discipline to turn ambiguous problems into precise, testable requirements. This role suits someone who is curious, comfortable in fast-moving technical discussions, and motivated by seeing their work show up in the tools developers use every day.

If you're passionate about developer tools and excited to help shape how the world programs quantum computers, we'd love to hear from you.

Responsibilities:

• Prioritize the Backlog: Own and maintain a prioritized backlog of features, improvements and bug fixes. Weigh user impact, business value, technical effort and dependencies. Make clear tradeoff calls and explain the reasoning to engineering and stakeholders.

• Define Requirements & Acceptance Criteria: Turn user needs, customer feedback and roadmap goals into clear product requirements and user stories with actionable, defined goals. Work with engineering and QA to confirm what ships meets those goals.

• Understand the Technology: Learn IonQ's compiler, gate sets, simulation and SDK architecture well enough to take part in technical tradeoff discussions. Know where compiler performance, circuit fidelity and developer usability pull against each other.

• Partner with Engineering: Embed with the developer tools and compiler engineering teams as their primary product counterpart. Join sprint planning, backlog grooming, design reviews and standups. Be available to answer product questions quickly so the team keeps moving.

• Ship and Iterate: Shepherd features from definition through release. Coordinate release notes, documentation and enablement with Developer Experience. Measure adoption and quality after launch, and feed what you learn back into the backlog.

- Define hardware requirements and reference architectures that scale across aircraft configurations

- Plan and run environmental, durability, and flight testing, analyze failures and crashes, and drive root cause and design fixes

- Be the technical authority and escalation point for hardware tradeoffs across mechanical, electrical, avionics, software, autonomy, and flight test

- Lead hardware design reviews, set engineering standards, and mentor other engineers

- Support flight test campaigns, demonstrations, and field operations

- BS/MS in Aerospace, Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics, or a related field

title: Demand Planning and Inventory Optimization Manager
description:
Our client, a dynamic Amazon FBA business with a global presence, is seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Demand Planning and Inventory Optimization Manager to join its Supply Chain Department. This role will lead efforts in forecasting demand, managing inventory levels, and optimizing stock for their entire catalog of products. As a key part of the Supply Chain team, this individual will ensure that the company maintains optimal stock levels while balancing cost efficiencies and operational requirements.
About the company:
The company is specialised on developing and upscaling Amazon-based brands across the USA, Canada, Europe, and the UK. With deep expertise in eCommerce and Amazon FBA, the company excels in buying, developing, and scaling brands to their fullest potential. The company's portfolio includes several Amazon brands, primarily in the home and kitchen category, as well as some electronics. Its international team of 17 world-class talents manages all operations today.
Key Responsibilities:

• Demand Planning: Analyze historical sales data, current product trends, and market insights to accurately forecast demand for all products.

• Inventory Management: Calculate and manage optimal inventory levels to ensure product availability while minimizing excess stock and associated costs.

• Order Management: Generate purchase orders for replenishment based on forecasted demand and stock levels, collaborating with suppliers to ensure timely deliveries.

• Stock Control & Optimization: Monitor and optimize stock levels across the catalog, ensuring products are always available in the required quantities and minimizing overstock.

• Analytics & Reporting: Provide regular reports on demand forecasts, stock status, and key performance indicators (KPIs). Use advanced analytics to recommend inventory adjustments and supply chain improvements.

• Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with brand managers, supply chain teams, and other stakeholders to align demand forecasts with marketing, promotions, and sales strategies.

• Amazon Marketplace Management: Oversee inventory management for Amazon, ensuring accurate stock levels, fulfillment coordination, and alignment with marketplace demand trends.

Qualifications:

• Proven experience in demand planning, inventory management, and supply chain operations, preferably in e-commerce.

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret large datasets and generate actionable insights.

• Experience managing inventory for the Amazon Marketplace, including knowledge of FBA (Fulfilled by Amazon) and related processes.

• High attention to detail and organizational skills.

• Experience working with international suppliers, especially from China, is a plus.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

• Proficiency in Google Spreadsheets, data analysis tools, and demand planning software

• Experience with Inventory Planner would be a plus

• This role is essential for maintaining efficient and cost-effective inventory management while supporting the companys growth through data-driven insights and precise demand forecasting.

What We Offer:

• Fully remote and full-time role.

• Paid time off.

• Yearly bonuses.

• Professional growth opportunities, such as managing staff members and growing your skill set.

• Competitive and timely salary.

• Opportunity to work remotely in an international company.

• Dynamic, creative work environments.

• Flexible schedule.

title: Vedoucí provozního úseku skladu | Nový sklad Opatovice nad Labem
description:
Rohlik otevírá nové distribuční centrum v Opatovicích nad Labem. To vytváří jedinečnou příležitost být u všeho hned od začátku, vdechnout novému skladu život a postavit fungující tým na směně.

Nehledáme člověka do kanceláře, ale lídra přímo do provozu. V téhle roli budeš mít přímý vliv na to, jak se nový sklad rozjede, jaká v něm bude kultura a jak hladce bude každý den fungovat logistika pro tisíce zákazníků.

 

PROČ JE TAHLE ROLE ZAJÍMAVÁ

- Od nuly: Dostaneš šanci rozjíždět nový projekt a zanechat na fungování nového distribučního centra svůj přímý otisk.

- Reálný dopad: Budeš mít přímý vliv na výkon směny, efektivitu provozu i spokojenost svého týmu.

- Akční prostředí: Nečeká tě stereotypní kancelářská práce - budeš přímo v centru dění moderní e-commerce logistiky.

- Datově řízený provoz: Provoz řídíme na základě dat v reálném čase, takže budeš pracovat s moderními systémy a chytrými nástroji.

- Prostor věci měnit: Dostaneš samostatnost aktivně upravovat a zefektivňovat procesy tam, kde uvidíš příležitost ke zlepšení.

CO TĚ U NÁS ČEKÁ

- Vedení týmu: Budeš vést, motivovat a rozvíjet tým na směně, plánovat kapacity, rozdělovat práci a budovat týmovou spolupráci.

- Odpovědnost za výkon: Budeš řídit směnu podle klíčových ukazatelů (KPI) a zodpovídat za plnění plánovaných cílů.

- Práce s daty: Budeš sledovat provozní čísla v reálném čase, vyhodnocovat výkon a včas reagovat na odchylky.

- Optimalizace procesů: Budeš hledat úzká místa v provozu a aktivně navrhovat i zavádět zlepšení.

- Spolupráce napříč skladem: Budeš úzce spolupracovat s ostatními vedoucími, aby celý tok zboží fungoval plynule.

- Směnný provoz: Pracovat budeš v režimu krátký/dlouhý týden na 12hodinových ranních a odpoledních směnách.

CO OD TEBE OČEKÁVÁME

- Zkušenost s vedením lidí: Máš prokazatelnou praxi s vedením, řízením a motivací týmu v dynamickém prostředí.

- Angličtinu pro běžnou pracovní komunikaci a řešení každodenních operativních situací.

- Analytické základy: Umíš pracovat s daty, běžně používáš PC a rychle se zorientuješ v interních logistických systémech.

- Samostatnost a odpovědnost: Umíš se rozhodnout, převzít odpovědnost a dotahovat věci do konce.

- Chuť rozvíjet sebe i svůj tým a fungovat v prostředí, kde se věci rychle mění.

- Zkušenost ze skladu, logistiky nebo výroby je výhodou, ne však absolutní podmínkou - klíčový je pro nás tvůj lídrovský přístup.

 

CO TI ZA TVOU SKVĚLOU PRÁCI NABÍDNEME?

- Rohlík Xtra účet zdarma - nakupuj s 10% cashbackem v podobě kreditů na další nákupy.

- Možnost extra placeného volna - když si potřebuješ pořádně odpočnout.

- Obědy & občerstvení zdarma - přímo na pracovišti tě čeká dobré jídlo, skvělé kafe a čerstvé ovoce/zelenina každý den.

- Sbírej hvězdičky a ulov si odměnu - máme super systém vnitrofiremních pochval. S kolegy si navzájem posíláte hvězdičky, které pak snadno proměníš za vouchery do Alzy, Notina a dalších e-shopů.

- Příspěvek na ošatné - ke každé směně ti přihodíme 86 Kč navíc na oblečení.

- Multisport karta - pro tvůj sport i zasloužený relax po práci.

- Fajn firemní akce - umíme vzít za práci, ale i společně oslavit úspěchy na skvělých večírcích.

Flosum is a bootstrapped, profitable B2B SaaS company building the leading Salesforce-native DevSecOps, Data Protection, and Security platform. Our solutions are trusted by Fortune 500 enterprises in the most heavily regulated industries on the planet - financial services, healthcare, government, and insurance.
We’re not a startup burning cash and chasing vanity metrics. We’re a proven, scaling business that reached profitability on our own terms. As a Salesforce Summit Partner and Innovation Award winner, we’ve earned our seat at the table alongside the biggest names in enterprise software.
Built 100% on the Salesforce platform. Serving enterprises that demand zero compromise on security, compliance, and reliability.
Why This Role Exists
We are entering an aggressive growth phase - expanding our product surface, deepening our platform capabilities, and accelerating our delivery velocity. We need senior-caliber Node.js developers who can own significant parts of our architecture and ship production code that enterprise customers depend on daily.

title: Payment Operations Specialist
description:
About FastSpring :

FastSpring is how AI, SaaS, gaming, software, and digital product companies sell online in more places around the world. We handle all payment needs from checkout to taxes so you can go farther faster.

Founded in 2005, we are a privately owned company headquartered in Santa Barbara with offices in Amsterdam, Austin, Belfast, Dublin, Halifax, and Singapore.

Payment Operations Specialist, Technical Operations
Department: Payment Operations | Location: Remote - United States | Reports To: Director of Trust and Safety
Position Overview:
The Payment Operations Specialist supports the day-to-day health of FastSpring 's payment ecosystem for our network of 2,500+ sellers, with a focus on chargeback management, KPI tracking, and issue resolution across multiple processors and regions. Working closely with senior team members, this role helps manage chargebacks, monitor payment performance, and investigate anomalies while supporting cross-functional efforts to reduce risk and improve the seller experience. It is an entry-to-early career role with room to grow into payments, risk, and fraud. Responsibilities & Goals:

• Assist with the end-to-end chargeback process, including preparing and submitting representments.

• Monitor chargeback volumes, win rates, and related KPIs using existing reports and tools.

• Coordinate with sellers and internal teams to collect supporting documentation for dispute responses.

• Monitor payment processor dashboards and alerts to identify potential issues or disruptions.

• Support Tier I-II payment-related inquiries from sellers and internal teams.

• Investigate routine issues involving settlements, refunds, disputes, or processor behavior.

• Help document and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) for chargebacks and payment operations.

Experience & Qualifications:

• 1+ years of experience in payments operations, chargebacks, customer support operations, finance operations, or a related role.

• Basic understanding of card payments and the chargeback/dispute lifecycle.

• Exposure to chargeback processing, payment processors, or merchant-of-record environments is a plus.

• Strong attention to detail and ability to follow documented processes.

• Strong organizational and communication skills.

• Interest in learning more about risk, fraud, and payment optimization.

• We welcome candidates from a range of backgrounds and experiences who bring fresh perspective to payment operations challenges.

Technology & Systems:

• Comfortable working with data, dashboards, and spreadsheets.

• Familiarity with payment processor dashboards or dispute management tools is a plus.

• Comfortable working across multiple platforms and systems in a fast-paced, globally distributed environment.

title: Lead Product Manager, Intercom Calling
description:
Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management. 

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries. 

About the Role

Intercom is one of the fastest-growing and most-loved product lines at Verkada, in a $1B+ market we've only begun to tap. At its core, the intercom connects people with the businesses and organizations they're visiting through a call. Whether you need to get into a building, drop off a package, ask about store hours or get help in an emergency, the intercom is how you reach a person who can help.

Calling is at the heart of the Intercom experience, and we need a product manager to own it end to end: every call, from the moment someone presses the button to the moment someone answers and helps them.

You'll own the underlying calling pipeline, enterprise-grade call routing, the context and controls that help people answering make better decisions, and the AI that automates call responses. Your job is to make every call reliable, productive and delightful.

We are committed to a thriving in-office culture. This role requires you to work onsite at our HQ in San Mateo, CA.

What You’ll Own

Calling stack: make every call great

• Define the roadmap for our signaling and media paths, across first- and third-party and online and offline pipelines

• Deliver a consistent answering experience on every endpoint: iOS, Android, web browsers, PSTN and VoIP

• Track the metrics that matter: ring rate, connection success rate, dropped calls and audio/video quality (load time, latency, packet loss, jitter, MOS)

• Address failure modes on real-world networks, including weak cellular links, restrictive enterprise firewalls and NAT traversal

• Manage relationships with subprocessors and technology partners, including corporate phone and communications platforms

Call routing: get every call to the best person available

• Add intelligence to routing based on audio and video triggers, building state (such as after hours or lockdown), schedules and staff availability

• Define what the caller experiences while their call is being routed

• Design strategies for concurrent calls: ring strategies (simultaneous, sequential, round robin), triage, queuing, forwarding and failover

• Build tools that let admins configure, test and manage routing at scale across many sites, users, and devices (including receiver groups, SCIM syncing)

Call context and controls: give the person answering superpowers

• Enrich calls with context for better decisions, such as live captions, nearby security camera feeds, visitor history and access logs

• Build advanced controls that put fast, powerful options at the answerer's fingertips, such as real-time voice translation, security escalation and multi-door unlocking

• Drive sophisticated video features such as two-way video, auto-framing and AI filters that improve the calling experience

AI receivers: use voice AI to streamline responses

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

HOW WE WORK

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company-from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role
ElevenLabs moves fast - and behind every high-performing leader is someone who makes sure nothing slips. This is a high-trust, hands-on role for someone who thrives in dynamic environments, holds themselves to a high standard, and takes genuine pride in making their lead's life easier - down to the small, considered details that others overlook.

You'll be the operational backbone for senior leadership - managing calendars, coordinating across time zones, handling logistics, and owning the day-to-day administrative tasks that let leadership focus on what matters most.

In this role, you will:

- Manage complex, fast-moving calendars and provide scheduling and coordination support across multiple time zones and geographies

- Handle sensitive and confidential matters with discretion, acting as a trusted partner in both professional and operational contexts

- Coordinate seamlessly with internal stakeholders across teams, as well as external partners and senior leaders

- Work closely with other EAs across the organisation to align schedules, share context, and keep cross-functional coordination running smoothly

- Anticipate needs before they arise: managing follow-ups, flagging conflicts, and keeping the right people aligned

Accenture Song accelerates growth and value for our clients by combining creativity, technology, and data-driven intelligence. Within Song, the Customer Technology - Commerce practice helps organizations design, build, and scale modern digital commerce ecosystems that deliver personalized, seamless, and intelligent customer experiences.
We integrate commerce platforms, customer data, marketing technology, and AI-powered decisioning to transform how brands engage customers across channels. By embedding Generative AI and Agentic AI into commerce operations, we enable real-time personalization, autonomous merchandising, dynamic pricing, campaign orchestration, and revenue growth at scale.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

• Work at the forefront of Agentic Commerce and Generative AI , building next-generation intelligent commerce ecosystems.

• Gain hands-on exposure to modern commerce platforms, composable architectures, CDPs, MarTech stacks, and AI orchestration frameworks .

• Collaborate with Song teams across Commerce, Experience, Marketing, and Data.

• Contribute to reusable accelerators and AI-driven commerce solution assets.

• Develop deep technical expertise and client-facing consulting skills within high-impact transformation programs.

What You Would Do in This Role
As an Agentic Commerce & AI Consultant , you will design and build AI-powered commerce solutions using Generative AI and multi-agent orchestration frameworks. You will take ownership of solution components, ensuring scalable, secure, and business-aligned deployments within customer technology ecosystems.

Agentic Commerce Solution Development

Cloud & Deployment

• Utilize Databricks for large-scale modeling workflows and AI experimentation.

Responsible AI & Performance Optimization

• Structured tool access

• Context governance

• Drift detection

• Implement LLM evaluation metrics, structured testing frameworks, and observability standards.

• Continuously optimize multi-agent systems for scalability, reliability, and commercial impact.

Consulting & Client Engagement

• Support development of client-ready presentations, demos, and value narratives.

description:
Qui sommes-nous ?
Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 5 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises.
La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement.

Pour rejoindre la Direction du Système d’Informations, nous recherchons notre futur(e) Responsable du groupe Support aux usagers qui pilotera l’offre de services numériques de l’environnement de travail pour Télécom Paris et ses partenaires.

Son périmètre intègre la gestion des solutions et du parc d’équipements individuels (collaboratif, bureautique, télétravail, téléphonie) et des solutions collectives ou audiovisuelles déployées dans les espaces mutualisés (salles de cours, de visioconférence, amphithéâtres et certaines solutions pour salles de travaux pratiques).
Le Responsable garantit également le support et l’accompagnement aux usages numériques de l'établissement et de ses partenaires, qui comprennent à ce jour la direction générale de l'Institut Mines-Télécom et l'Institut Polytechnique de Paris.

Les principales missions sont les suivantes :

• Diriger, animer et coordonner l’équipe

• Élaborer et maintenir l’offre de services

• Piloter la bonne exécution des projets et services

• Participer aux activités de support

Détails des missions dans la description de poste complète.

• l’encadrement et le management d’une équipe technique

• l’organisation d’une activité de support et pilotage de prestations de services numériques

• de solides connaissances des postes de travail, imprimantes et périphériques, ainsi que des matériels de vidéoprojection, de visioconférence et de sonorisation

• la maîtrise des environnements Microsoft Windows et GNU/Linux et des principales suites bureautiques ; connaissances des architectures de domaines et de configuration et des réseaux locaux (Ethernet, TCP/IP)

• capacité à analyser les besoins, participer à la formalisation d’une offre de services, suivre une feuille de route et utiliser des tableaux de bord ; pratique des démarches qualité et des processus ITSM

• capacités de coordination avec les usagers, les autres équipes de la DSI et les prestataires ; rédaction de procédures et de spécifications techniques.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?
Vous travaillerez dans un environnement agréable, verdoyant et accessible (notamment pour les personnes en situation de handicap) à seulement 20 km de Paris (RER B et C, proximité des grands axes routiers, navette mutualisée en partance de la Porte d'Orléans). Vous bénéficierez de :

• 49 jours de congés annuels (CA + RTT).

• Flexibilité des horaires de travail (en fonction de l'activité du service).

• Télétravail 1 à 3 jours/semaine possible.

• Proximité de nombreuses infrastructures sportives, conciergerie, parking souterrain, restauration interne.

• A savoir : nos cotisations sociales sont moins élevées que dans le secteur privé.

The Global Payroll Analyst is a 9-month fixed-term contract (FTC) role responsible for optimizing global payroll processes and analyzing payroll data to support accurate, timely, and compliant operations. As part of the Global Payroll team, this person will identify discrepancies and trends, support payroll processing and audits, improve controls and workflows, and translate complex data into actionable recommendations. The role works closely with external providers and partners across payroll operations, finance, people, and process excellence.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Collect, analyze, and interpret multi-country payroll data to support accurate processing, reporting, and decision-making.

- Validate payroll inputs and outputs; identify and resolve discrepancies involving employee records, benefits, taxes, deductions, and payments.

- Support payroll processing and help ensure country-level payroll and tax compliance.

- Conduct regular payroll audits and reconcile payroll records with general-ledger accounts.

- Investigate trends and root causes, then recommend practical improvements to accuracy, efficiency, controls, and compliance.

- Use payroll systems, HR systems, spreadsheets, and data-transformation tools to improve reporting and workflows.

- Coordinate payroll activity and data exchange with external vendors and cross-functional partners.

- Respond to payroll-related questions professionally and resolve issues with appropriate urgency.

- Maintain current knowledge of payroll regulations and industry practices, translating changes into operational updates.

- Strengthen documentation, controls, and team practices so improvements are repeatable and scalable.

CORE REQUIREMENTS:

- 3+ years of experience in payroll analysis or related payroll/finance roles.

- Hands-on multi-country payroll experience and a strong understanding of payroll tax and compliance requirements.

- Demonstrated experience analyzing large datasets, investigating discrepancies, and producing actionable insights.

- Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, including lookups, pivot tables, and efficient data manipulation.
